investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-10-07T01:06:12Z with an identical 502 bad-gateway error indicating the swarm gateway ELB endpoint at /v1/agents was unreachable during agent provisioning. Because the failure occurs at the very first POST /api/agents call and all sibling checks share the exact same error message, the swarm gateway is the single shared upstream dependency whose unavailability caused every required evidence field (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) to go uncollected.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting the /v1/agents provisioning endpoint — was unreachable at the time of the eval run. The production-api layer returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" on every POST /api/agents attempt, preventing agent creation from starting and leaving all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) empty. This is localized to the swarm gateway / remote-agent provisioning path; no evidence of a broader production-api outage or user-traffic impact is present in the supplied packet.
